title: 12. Magnet-Magnet Fruit (Jiki Jiki no Mi), with awakening
facts: Fruit look from the user's oparchive screenshots (refs/batch3/DESIGNS.md)

plan.english: 12. Magnet-Magnet Fruit (Jiki Jiki no Mi), with awakening
plan.fruit: Drawn from the design you sent (refs/batch3).

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird ring-wrapped blue#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird ring-wrapped blue fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: a Paramecia#orange that lets you control magnetism,#green and it can even awaken.
lines.say: a Paramecia that lets you control magnetism, and it can even awaken.

lines.text: First, you pull metal toward#blue you from everywhere.#orange
lines.say: First, you pull metal toward you from everywhere.

lines.text: Then you build#red a giant#green arm out of scrap metal.
lines.say: Then you build a giant arm out of scrap metal.

lines.text: You can even push metal#pink away and fire it like bullets.#green
lines.say: You can even push metal away and fire it like bullets.

lines.text: And once you awaken it, you can make anything#blue magnetic,#green even people.
lines.say: And once you awaken it, you can make anything magnetic, even people.

lines.text: The power only works on metal unless#blue it's awakened.#pink
lines.say: The power only works on metal unless it's awakened.

lines.text: Eustass#pink Kid used it to take#blue down Big Mom with Law in Wano.
lines.say: Eustass Kid used it to take down Big Mom with Law in Wano.

lines.text: Users of this fruit never lose#green their keys.#orange
lines.say: Users of this fruit never lose their keys.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
